name: Huang Shilin
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2018-2025); Hurun Global (2019-2026); Hurun China (2018-2026)
forbes_bio: Huang Shilin is a former vice chairman of Contemporary Amperex Technology (CATL), one of the world's largest battery suppliers for the electric vehicle industry.
Huang resigned from the board in 2022.
CATL, dual-listed in Hong Kong and Shenzhen, supplies batteries to automakers including BMW, Geely and Tesla.
Despite repeated pushbacks amid geopolitical concerns, a Ford battery factory in Michigan that licenses technologies from CATL has been completed in June 2026.

name: Pyotr Aven
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2006-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: Pyotr Aven is a co-owner of Alfa Bank and LetterOne along with Mikhail Fridman, Khan and fellow billionaires Alexei Kuzmichev and Andrei Kosogov.
Aven and his partners were all sanctioned by the EU and U.K. in February and March 2022; Aven stepped down from LetterOne's board in March.
He grew up in Moscow, graduated from Moscow State University, and worked at the Institute for Systems Studies at the Soviet Academy of Sciences.
In 1989 he went to work at the Ministry of Foreign Affairs; two years later he was tapped to be Putin's minister of foreign economic relations.
Aven was president of Russia's largest privately held bank, Alfa-Bank, which was hit with sanctions in April 2022, from 1994 to 2011.
forbes_facts: Aven now owns the largest private collection of Russian art.

name: Lee Bass
appears_on: Forbes real-time (2026); Forbes annual (2001-2025); Hurun Global (2014-2026)
forbes_bio: In 1959 Lee Bass and his three brothers inherited $2.8 million each from oil tycoon uncle Sid Richardson.
The brothers parlayed their inheritance into multi-billion-dollar fortunes with the help of bets on oil that paid off big.
In early 2017 the four Bass brothers sold their oil company to ExxonMobil for $5.6 billion in stock.
Bass owns El Coyote and La Paloma ranches in Texas' Rio Grande Plains, where he raises longhorn cattle.
forbes_facts: Avid conservationists, the Basses have funded efforts to reintroduce the Aplomado falcon in Texas.
Bass and his brothers inherited St. Jo island, near Corpus Christi, Texas. A barrier island 28 miles long, it was hit by Hurricane Harvey in August 2017.

name: Ji Wei
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Hurun Global (2020-2026); Hurun China (2006-2026)
forbes_bio: Ji Wei is chairman and founder of Wasion, a provider of energy metering equipment, systems, and related services.
Established in 2000, the company has expanded to include four overseas subsidiaries: Wasion Mexico, Wasion Brazil, Wasion Tanzania and Wasion Hungary (Europe).
The company has over 6,000 employees worldwide.

name: Kiki Barki
appears_on: Forbes real-time (former) (2026); Forbes annual (2011-2024); Hurun Global (2014-2024)
forbes_bio: Coal entrepreneur Kiki Barki founded Harum Energy in 1995 and listed it in 2010.
His eldest son Lawrence runs Harum as president commissioner while youngest son Steven Scott is commissioner.
Kiki also owns a privately held coal mine, Tanito Harum.
The family owns a stake in Australia-listed Nickel Industries, which has one nickel mine and two nickel pig iron plants in Indonesia.
Grandson Nathan is a minority shareholder of Indonesia-listed oil and gas firm Medco Energi Internasional and gold-and-copper mining company Amman Mineral Internasional.
